content: Algorithmic trading risk failures: harm often arises not from model inaccuracy itself but from failures executing automatically without sufficient controls -- e.g. Knight Capital 2012, 40M lost in 45 minutes from a software deployment bug, not a bad model. ML integration risks: overfitting, data bias, interpretability gaps. High-reliability-organization practices (redundant checks, kill switches, monitoring) reduce technological risk in algo trading firms. Operational failures (software glitches, connectivity issues) are a distinct and major risk category separate from model/strategy risk.
